description: UNDERSTANDING — facet-level scores for every member of a cohort, each with the cohort average and the delta against it. A 60 in governance means nothing until you know the market sits at 45; this is the endpoint that says so. Priced per result — $0.005 per request plus $0.0002 per record returned (less past 100), capped at $0.50 a request, under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. Estimate first at /api/v1/prices/estimate. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

name: cohort_scores
